description: types.rs previously had 5 tests: invocation round-trip, request round-trip, response omits null createdIds, error type serializes camelCase, requestTooLarge includes limit. These were deleted along with the hand-rolled types. Now stoa-mail has no tests that catch a serialization regression in jmap-types (e.g. a field rename in JmapResponse). Add integration-level tests covering these serialization invariants, driven by the wire format not the internal types.
title: Serialization conformance tests for JMAP wire types deleted
